78-2226-2499.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
78-2226-2499.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Steel Leaf Paladin by paying its mana cost.
When Steel Leaf Paladin enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2645-3430-5233-5475.easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-5233-5475.description:
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Boros Garrison
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

236-1742-1978-3363.notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has a burden counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
236-1742-1978-3363.description:
Animate The One Ring using Bring to Life.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat from step 2.

3835-4050-8077-8107.description:
Cast Raffine's Guidance from your graveyard by paying {W} due to Sage of the Beyond.
Sigil of the Empty Throne triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve Raffine's Guidance, attaching it to another creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Raffine's Guidance attached, adding {W}.
Repeat.

413-5662--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
413-5662--5--195.description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reyhan trigger.
Resolve Reyhan's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1894-2173-5220-7918.description:
Cast Bile Urchin by paying its mana cost.
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

141-7495.easyPrerequisites: There is a legal target for All Aboard.
141-7495.description:
Cast a copy of All Aboard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying All Aboard, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of All Aboard, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.

2059-5231-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Village Bell-Ringer, adding at least one mana.
Repeat.

1086-1594-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Anointer Priest trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1086-1594-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3755-4927-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3755-4927-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3755-4927-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

5641-7363.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Basking Broodscale's adapt ability by paying {1}{G}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1322-3259-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

465-4681-6797.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3398-5921-7121.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
3398-5921-7121.description:
Activate Fire Nation Palace's second ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, giving Hellkite Charger firebending 4 until end of turn.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering it and its firebending ability twice.
Resolve both Hellkite Charger firebending triggers, adding eight {R}.
Resolve the first Hellkite Charger trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

803-2366-2921-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
803-2366-2921-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-560-1358-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Sydri.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

215-527-876.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Selvala that has power 7 or greater.
215-527-876.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Selvala.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

147-2562-5231.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

141-2034-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet

390-2760-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Hulking Metamorph.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hulking Metamorph by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3525-4832-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
3525-4832-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3525-4832-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

3490-4476-4659-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4476-4659-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Answered Prayers indestructible.
3490-4476-4659-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1445-2060-4452-6413.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2060-4452-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

198-643-3767-3918.manaNeeded: {1} if Trazyn doesn't have a charge counter on it
198-643-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
198-643-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Trazyn and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on Trazyn.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1491-3129-6006-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-3129-6006-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-3129-6006-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

478-1460-2821-3918.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four artifacts.
Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-1460-2821-3918.description:
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

1636-2511-2527-3143.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2511-2527-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

974-3525-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-3525-4183.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}{R}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Saheeli.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other creature(s) or artifact(s) you control.

5231-5660-5713.description:
Cast Iron Apprentice by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Iron Apprentice, adding {R}.
When Iron Apprentice dies, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Iron Apprentice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2609-3490-4871-5375.description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}.
Witch-Maw Nephilim's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Recruit the Worthy, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
When the Soldier dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may forego sacrificing the Servos and/or Soldiers.

927-3950.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Kukemssa Serpent.
A player controls no Islands.
927-3950.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving control of Kukemssa Serpent to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Kukemssa Serpent's controller controls no Islands, Kukemssa Serpent triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Kukemssa Serpent cannot be sacrificed due to its ability.
Kukemssa Serpent triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

575-2034-2795-4178.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Thelonite Hermit, adding {C}{C}.
Thelonite Hermit dies, triggering Yedora, returning Thelonite Hermit from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Thelonite Hermit by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Thelonite Hermit's morph ability by paying {3}{G}{G}, turning it face up.
Thelonite Hermit triggers, creating four 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1283-4019-5089.notablePrerequisites:
Chromatic Orrery does not have summoning sickness.
Chromatic Orrery has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1283-4019-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Chromatic Orrery to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {2}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability instead to draw infinite cards.

2006-2452.description:
Cast Sedraxis Alchemist by paying {0}.
Sedraxis Alchemist enters the battlefield, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.
